text_simplified: The text discusses the concept of 'nātiqshilā'—aggressive or harmful behaviour among children. It emphasises the necessity of protecting children from physical and psychological harm, while stressing the importance of early intervention to prevent the problem from worsening. It recommends reinforcing moral values and positive tarbiyah (upbringing) to reduce such behaviour.

review_defects.arabic: سلوك عدواني أو إيذاء بين الأطفال
review_defects.english: aggressive or harmful behaviour among children
review_defects.why: The Arabic distinguishes between 'aggressive behaviour' (سلوك عدواني) and 'harm' (إيذاء) as a separate noun, whereas the English merges both into a single adjectival phrase 'aggressive or harmful behaviour', slightly altering the nuance.
